changes: Rebuilt the old 18-by-17 single-room tower as a 10-by-12 keep with separate floors at 0/3/6 units, a half-step west stair, upper records room and a watch turret over ten units high. The tribute roll is upstairs at (45.5,31.5,3). Ground hall, roof and turret are reachable without jumps.

Three siege assaults now contain 3/4/3 opponents (ten total), retaining the old tide-captain identity 977247 and saved phases/defeats. Raiders march toward the player, use the actual layered pathfinder and keep pursuit beyond the old six-tile leash. Normal NPC combat, collision and cooldowns still resolve hits; the landing remains protected. Guards support rather than overwhelm the baseline enemies.

Added dedicated spear-and-shield Fomorian models and a larger armoured crested captain, with bounded directional animation caches. Pirate and player art are unchanged. One store-thief gives the opening shore errand an early encounter and cannot be farmed by reloading.

Useful quest objects respond directly when their task is ready. The sailor rescue moves through the real shore route and waits if the player falls behind; progress resumes after reload. Shelter/launch work takes four seconds nearby in the world, pauses in dialogue and cancels if the player retreats or an enemy reaches the rescue.

Completed errands, the watchfire, each defeated assault and the departure council award one-use chapter XP (575 total before combat XP). A level-one character earns a level and stat points; already-completed work grants missing XP once on a return visit. Silver rewards, inventory and story chronology are preserved.

JRPG body text uses a fixed size tied to the chat text setting. It wraps and pages long passages, preserves stat symbols and long words, and waits until the final visual page before offering story choices. Visual paging does not rewrite authored dialogue or story counters. Short lines retain a single advance to finish.

Legacy saved positions that intersect the new keep recover before coordinates are restored. Saved chapter phases, defeated actors, inventory and the onward voyage remain. Client/server NPC context points to the upstairs roll and updated assaults. The current devlog is v111 with condensed history.
